metric: Labelled claims about a query's output (column never NULL, columns unique, at most or exactly one row) found by the deterministic analysis; false claims must not be asserted.
caveats: Tuned on test: the development cases (76 queries) were used to fix the analysis; the first run proved 83 of 88. The rollup regression case (2 claims) is unsupported. Held-out and SQLSolver-query results are separate rows.
correctness: 0 wrong; all 53 false labels verified by a violating random database, no true label violated
held_out: 39/41 true claims proved, 0 wrong (32 queries, 55 claims, other schema, run once after the analysis was frozen; the 2 misses are CASE guarded by IS NULL and ROW_NUMBER uniqueness)
